answer: Hide a few planted test items in every grading queue. Each one is a pearl of known quality: some are polished, some are clearly broken, and no grader can tell them apart from real work. A sybil ring that rubber-stamps its own members will also wave through the broken plants, and that pattern stands out like a comet against a quiet sky. Honest graders pass these hidden checks without effort, so their seats grow, while the ring's shared reef of fake approvals collapses into lost weight.
